verdict.rationale: The only robots.txt evidence is for a related New York state portal, not the Department of State's own hosts. That file (businessexpress.ny.gov) returns HTTP 200 with a "Disallow: /" block, so an agent there can tell it may not crawl. No robots.txt probe exists for dos.ny.gov, and the filings.dos.ny.gov host reset the connection, so nothing could be read from it. Missing for 10: a robots.txt confirmed on dos.ny.gov itself, one for the filing host, and per-path allow rules that say what agents may read rather than a blanket disallow.
